description: This file defines an abstract class ShadowCheckpointService for managing git-based checkpoints in a workspace, including initialization, saving, restoring, and diffing checkpoints, with integration of external services like telemetry and VSCode warnings.

classes.name: ShadowCheckpointService
classes.description: An abstract class providing functionality for managing git-based checkpoints within a workspace, including initialization, checkpoint creation, restoration, diffing, and branch management, with event emission and error handling.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Captures and reports an error event via TelemetryService.

methods.name: showWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning message in VSCode if less than 5 warnings have been shown.

methods.name: createSanitizedGit
methods.description: Creates a SimpleGit instance with environment variables sanitized to prevent interference.

methods.name: initShadowGit
methods.description: Initializes a shadow git repository in the checkpoints directory, handling existing repos and nested git repos.

methods.name: writeExcludeFile
methods.description: Writes exclude patterns to the git info/exclude file.

methods.name: stageAll
methods.description: Stages all files in the git repository, with error handling.

methods.name: getNestedGitRepository
methods.description: Detects nested git repositories within the workspace.

methods.name: getShadowGitConfigWorktree
methods.description: Retrieves the core.worktree configuration of the shadow git repository.

methods.name: saveCheckpoint
methods.description: Creates a new checkpoint (commit) with a message, optionally allowing empty commits.

methods.name: restoreCheckpoint
methods.description: Restores the workspace to a specific checkpoint (commit).

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Generates a diff of changes between two commits or the current state.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event via EventEmitter.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Registers a one-time event listener.

methods.name: hashWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the workspace directory path.

methods.name: taskRepoDir
methods.description: Generates the directory path for a task's checkpoints.

methods.name: workspaceRepoDir
methods.description: Generates the directory path for workspace checkpoints.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task's branch in the checkpoint repository.

methods.name: deleteBranch
methods.description: Deletes a git branch, handling current branch and cleanup.
